claims.text: A 60-second apnea event was detected in recording a01 starting at 2000-01-01T00:42:00+00:00 and ending at 00:43:00+00:00, corresponding to window index 42.

The detector flagged this window as an anomaly with a reconstruction error of 0.3232, exceeding the anomaly threshold of 0.0453, yielding a normalized margin of 6.136; these values are reconstruction threshold evidence and not probabilities or calibrated confidence.
The model is a BiLSTM temporal-attention autoencoder (version apnea-01-a01_seed2026) trained on the apnea dataset, with test patient a01 and fold ID apnea-01-a01.
The primary signal channel is ECG with 6000 samples at 100 Hz; additional derived channels include mean, std, min, max, range, slope, and energy.

Temporal attention for this window has a mean of 0.0100 and peaks at 00:42:29.400+00:00; this represents shared window-level temporal relevance, not probability, calibrated confidence, or channel-specific importance.
The current event is supported by detector, signal, and attention evidence; no longitudinal PDM context or clinical context was supplied in this package.
